summary.en: A word slams in glyph by glyph from one and a half times its size on a spring, a misregistered ghost flashing under it, the camera punching in on the landing.
summary.zh: 一个词逐字从 1.5 倍大小弹簧般砸下，下面闪过一道套印错位的残影，落地时镜头前推一下。

fits: Every word entrance of a beat-cut type film.
notFor: Calm films; body text; anything read while it moves.

intent.en: Each word is a hit you can see: big to small, blur to sharp, with a printing ghost.
intent.zh: 每个词都是看得见的一下重击：由大到小、由糊到清，带着印刷残影。

fits.zh: 踩拍剪的文字片里每一个词的入场。

notFor.zh: 安静的片子；正文；边动边读的内容。

pairs.note: the full stop landing with it

en: Slam, never bounce: the spring overshoots under 8 %.
zh: 是砸，不是弹：弹簧过冲不到 8 %。

overlaps.note: general text entrances; this is ink's heavy per-glyph slam with the ghost and the punch

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
